title: diqduq
text:
A python package leveraging LLMs with dspy to analyze the syntax of passages of Biblical Hebrew.
diqduq offers an alternative analytic scheme to Universal Dependencies, designed to describe Hebrew syntax in familiar terms that are convenient for research and teaching. Released under the GNU General Public License v3 or later.
